## Appearance

Lavendar Lewis is a little lady with an almost girlish, pink-cheeked face featuring pretty cheeks, sweet lips, and dimples. Her thick, snow-white hair is quite gray, beautifully wavy, and carefully arranged in becoming puffs and coils. She has sweet, big, soft brown eyes with a wood-brown shade and golden glints, and over time she has grown even sweeter and prettier.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P2](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0002), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P25](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0025), [v3 ch.People P3](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0003)_

## Personality

Lavendar Lewis is an imaginative individual who relies on pretending as a way to cope with life. Self-described as a dreadfully sulky person, she also maintains a rebellious attitude regarding the process of aging.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)_

## History

Lavendar Lewis lived at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with her young helper, Charlotta the Fourth, combatting loneliness by hosting imaginary tea parties. After meeting [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), Lavendar recounted her long-ago romance and quarrel with her former fiancé, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later introduced Lavendar to Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), with whom she formed a close friendship over their shared imaginary dream-people. Following a period of despondency, Lavendar reunited with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), and the two were subsequently married. She later hosted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confided in her about rejecting [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's romantic feelings.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), +19 more_

## Quotes

> "But oh, won’t you stay and have tea with me? Please, do. Mr. Kimball’s will have tea over before you get there. And Charlotta the Fourth and I will be so glad to have you."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)

> "to believe I’m old. Now, who are you . . . just for convenience’ sake? Diana Barry? And Anne Shirley? May I pretend that I’ve known you for a hundred years and call you Anne and Diana right away?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062)

> "I love them myself. They are very good company . . . with a little pretending. On calm evenings Charlotta the Fourth and I often sit out here and amuse ourselves with them. Charlotta, take back the horn and hang it carefully in its place."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P74](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0074)

> "It gave me a shock to hear about Stephen’s son that first day you were here, Anne. I’ve never been able to mention him to you since, but I’ve wanted to know all about him. What sort of a boy is he?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P21](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0021)

> "Oh, I’m not so old as I thought . . . and I don’t need a single blue pill! Girls, when you come back with your strawberries we’ll have tea out here under the silver poplar. I’ll have it all ready for you with home-grown cream."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P36](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--lavendar-lewis.md)

Miss Lavendar and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) share a close, affectionate friendship, visiting often to exchange confidences and company. Their acquaintance began when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lost her way in the woods and arrived at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) during one of Miss Lavendar's imaginative tea parties. Over time, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) became a trusted confidante, hearing the story of Miss Lavendar's past romance and later helping her confide personal matters.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +8 more_

- Friend of — visiting friends who share affection and confidences  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P34](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0034), [v3 ch.People P22](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0022)</sub>

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta the Fourth serves as Miss Lavendar's young handmaiden at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Beyond performing household duties and helping entertain guests, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) deeply cares for her employer's wellbeing, noticing and worrying when Miss Lavendar suffers from despondency or loneliness.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +21 more_

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--lavendar-lewis.md)

[Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) is a frequent visitor to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) who brings youth and cheer to Miss Lavendar's home. She first met Miss Lavendar alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) after getting lost in the woods, later returning to share tea and help prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for Miss Lavendar's wedding.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +10 more_

### [Irving](../character/irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--lavendar-lewis.md)

Miss Lavendar rekindled her romance with Mr. [Irving](../character/irving.md) after a long separation stemming from a past quarrel. Their renewed courtship involved taking walks together in the garden, and they are presumed to be husband and wife following a joyful wedding ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge).

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--paul-irving.md)
